notes.title: An original soundtrack was written for Once in Yaissor 3!
notes.content:
We've recreated a great idea with music to immerse our favorite reader in the oil.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40041062/8e27b3f9c53cac289423df75b6b4cccead6dcdd2.png[/img]

A mysterious soundtrack performed by screenwriter [b][url=https://vk.com/neuverennost]Kuredo[/url][/b] and his best friend [b][url=https://vk.com/nefazodone]Nefazodone[/url][/b].

You'll be able to experience it all in December!


[b]Hurry up and add it to your wishlist![/b]
Zema will be happy about it!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42693791/388419beb59a8c063b002b889ae6cf85db8fdf22.png[/img]

notes.content:
